summary: The track scope matches the owner order: 31 card rows of list v7, 62 files, delivery folder, handoff folder with MANIFEST.txt and a contact sheet, Drive backup, spend log with a 1.60 USD stop, PM report, and the T180 fixture move. The input facts check out: 227 rows, 31 card rows, the first 196 rows are non-card, all 13 reference paths exist, and the guard and judge scripts behave as the spec states. The spec and the plan leave the judge-batch card input shape to the implementer (F1, Blocker). Three smaller findings stay open (F2 to F4). Note: measure/anti-patterns.md does not exist in this repository; the reviewer ran the standard's checks without it (orchestrator ruling, 2026-11-06).
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] plan.md Task 2: The plan says the judge batch reads the card specs and counts card tries from the card start time, but it names no input shape for that. scripts/storytime-judge-batch.mjs:36 fixes SPEC_DIR to the A-48 folder, line 43 fixes RESTART_START, and parseArgs (lines 183-198) has no flag for a spec folder or a start time. Rationale: The implementer must choose between a new flag, an environment variable, or an added default folder. That is an API and CLI shape choice, so Red and Green can pick differently.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] spec.md Tries and spend: The spec says the card run start time is a constant that Task 2 sets, but it names no single owner for the value. Plan Task 2 also says the judge batch counts card tries from the card start time. Rationale: A second copy of the constant in scripts/storytime-judge-batch.mjs (RESTART_START, line 43) can drift from the guard value, and the try count then reads the wrong rows. Name one exported constant and the module that imports it.

F3 [Major] spec.md FR-3 and plan.md Task 3: The card spec test reads /home/daniebo/Desktop/Workbooks/content/storytime/l2/print/pictures.json, and the plan defines a SHA mismatch as a hard failure. The plan does not define the case where the Workbooks checkout is absent. Rationale: No test in tests/ reads that absolute path today, so the new test fails a full suite run on every checkout without Workbooks. Define the absent-file edge case.
F4 [Nit] plan.md Task markers: Every work task uses [b], and the doctor counts only [ ], [~], and [x]. Rationale: A role that reads the marker list sees no open work task for this track.

paraphrase.proposes: The track draws the 31 card rows that list v7 adds to the Storytime Level 2 print list. Each card needs a color picture and a line-art picture, so the track delivers 62 files at 1500 x 1500. It reuses the approved Storytime Muse path, the frozen Sonnet judge kit, and the week delivery form, and it adds no new kit. It also moves the T180 version 3 list fixture from /tmp/opencode/wb-shadow into the repository. The spend cap is 1.60 USD, the delivery is model evidence only, and Workbooks checks the cards after delivery.
paraphrase.current_system: The closed unit 1 track already holds the Muse path: scripts/storytime-muse.mjs calls meta/muse-image through OpenRouter and writes the print file to the spec outDir. scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs reads every costs.tsv below out/storytime/l2/unit1/ and enforces 3 tries per id and kind, a 1.00 USD cap since 2026-11-04T07:54:00Z, and a 0.50 USD report point. scripts/storytime-judge-batch.mjs builds judge batches for the A-48 specs at a 360 px long side for a card. The A-48 delivery form is the StorytimeManifest object in src/storytime/book-pictures.ts, with the MANIFEST.txt form of the week handoff. Two tests read the version 3 list from /tmp/opencode/wb-shadow, and that path is not in git.
